one_line_question: Is the staged L1 record-identifier repair for the defective exact_locator column mechanically complete and provenance-safe across all 97 ledger rows at the pinned hash, so that the owner of record could apply it without inventing any value?
why_this_task: REC-35 withholds G-LIT partly on the L1 evidence-binding defect (worker-005 HF-W005-L0-01, worker-025 locator adjudication revise). worker-025 F5 claims a complete staged repair (97/97 record-identifier replacements drawn from each row's own fields). That claim is decision input for astra-life05-verify-l0-final (audit lead, 02:30) and has not been independently verified end-to-end; worker-099 verified only the 10-row AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH class and my own earlier spot check #4 covered rows 1-40 only. This task verifies the recipe for all 97 rows offline, read-only, with its own implementation.
not_claimed: No theorem, no counterexample, no numerical result.
No node status, no gate verdict, no validation_status (worker events cannot set those).
Does not re-adjudicate whether the ledger CONTENT is correct (worker-005/025 scope), only whether the repair recipe is complete and provenance-safe.
Does not apply any repair and does not write ledger/citation_audit.csv or any other canonical path.
Does not endorse worker-025's live-fetch results (this run is offline).
fail_closed: The instrument refuses to run (exit 3, no report) if any frame pin does not match at load or if any pin moves between the pre-run and post-run measurement. The revision_note on the output binds the result to the measured ledger hash.
independence: worker-073 authored none of the reviewed bytes (ledger, worker-025 report or script, acceptance note). The instrument imports no worker-025 code; the exact_locator census and the provenance derivation are re-implemented from the raw CSV bytes. worker-025's proposed_staged_locator values are treated as the object under test, not as evidence for their own validity.

criteria.C1_coverage: Every one of the 97 data rows (SRC-001..SRC-097) carries a non-empty proposed_staged_locator in the pinned report.
criteria.C2_provenance_no_invention: Each proposed locator must be supported by the row's OWN fields only: string-equal to one of {doi, arxiv_id, url, evidence_url, exact_locator} (after trim), or a canonical record URL mechanically derivable from one of {doi, arxiv_id} of that row (https://doi.org/<doi>, https://dx.doi.org/<doi>, https://arxiv.org/abs/<arxiv_id>, https://export.arxiv.org/abs/<arxiv_id>, with a bare identifier accepted as its canonical URL form). A proposed locator that no own-field of its row can produce is an INVENTED failure.
criteria.C3_record_identity: Each proposed locator is a single-record identifier, not a discovery query, classified into exactly one of: RECORD_DOI (doi.org / dx.doi.org with a 10.* suffix), RECORD_ARXIV (arxiv.org/abs/<id> or export.arxiv.org/abs/<id>), RECORD_INSPIRE (inspirehep.net/literature/<digits>, not an /api/...?q= query), RECORD_ARTICLE_PAGE (publisher/article page whose path contains a DOI or a stable article identifier and whose query string contains no free-text q=/search= parameter), RECORD_API (single-record metadata endpoint of the form api.crossref.org/works/<doi>, counted as a record but flagged NON_PRIMARY), else FAIL_QUERY (search/discovery query with a free-text q=/search_query/search= parameter), FAIL_ELLIPSIS (contains the literal substring '...'), FAIL_BARE (scheme-less host or bare domain with no record path), FAIL_OTHER.
criteria.C4_malformed_subclass_closure: Every row whose exact_locator contains the literal substring '...' (the malformed subclass reported by worker-025) has a proposed value that satisfies C2 and C3 and differs from its defective exact_locator.
criteria.C5_class_coverage: Repair readiness is reported per frozen class for rows whose class_mapping is exactly one frozen class id. Rows with a disjunctive token (e.g. AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN;AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN) or the non-class token '(evidence/tag only)' are reported in separate buckets and are never assigned to a single class (project rule: no class leakage).
criteria.C6_census_reproduction: My own classification of the 97 exact_locator values into DIRECT / DISCOVERY / TRUNCATED / OTHER, computed from the raw CSV bytes, must agree with worker-025's row['exact_locator_class'] on all 97 rows; every disagreement is reported.
criteria.C7_determinism: Two consecutive runs must produce byte-identical report bodies (no wall-clock or path-dependent fields in the compared content).

controls_expected_to_fire.K5_foreign_value: proposed := another row's locator that the own row cannot produce -> C2 INVENTED
controls_expected_to_fire.K6_bare_doi_canonicalized: proposed := bare 10.* when the row's doi field equals it -> C2 pass, C3 RECORD_DOI (positive control)
controls_expected_to_fire.K7_crossref_api_record: proposed := api.crossref.org/works/<doi> matching the row's own evidence_url -> C3 RECORD_API (record, NON_PRIMARY flag)
controls_expected_to_fire.K9_defective_reuse: a '...' row whose proposed value is set back to its defective exact_locator -> C4 fail

decision_rule.REPAIR_READY_ALL: C1 and C2 and C4 and C6 pass with zero INVENTED/FAIL rows and all controls fire -> every row has a mechanically derivable record identifier; the owner may apply it and the resulting hash move voids all pre-move L1 verdicts (CF-19 discipline).
decision_rule.REPAIR_READY_WITH_RESIDUAL: C1, C2, C4, C6 pass, but at least one proposed locator classifies RECORD_API or other NON_PRIMARY record form -> report the residual rows explicitly; the recipe is still complete but not uniformly primary-page.
decision_rule.REPAIR_NOT_READY: any C1/C2/C4/C6 failure, any unfired control, or any pin move -> report the failing rows and stop; do not repair anything.
decision_rule.verdict_mapping: REPAIR_READY_ALL -> review accept; REPAIR_READY_WITH_RESIDUAL -> review accept with findings (or revise if the residual is material); REPAIR_NOT_READY -> review revise.

falsifier: Re-run artifacts/worker-073/l1_repair_readiness/run_check_073_l1repair.py at ledger/citation_audit.csv#315c19145065: this verification is falsified if any row's proposed locator is not derivable from its own fields, if any proposed locator is a discovery query, contains '...', or is otherwise not a single-record identifier, if any '...' row lacks a valid distinct replacement, if my census disagrees with worker-025's on any row, if a pre-registered control does not fire, or if any frame pin moves. A write to the ledger voids the binding immediately.
limits: Offline: the repair's identifiers are validated structurally against the row's own fields, NOT by live HTTP resolution; liveness of the proposed targets is worker-025/099 scope and is not claimed here.
The row population is fixed at the 97 data rows present at the pinned ledger hash.
class_mapping is used only as the ledger's own declared binding; this task does not re-adjudicate class binding (HF-02/A0 scope).
